title: A little  wobbly
text:

product_metadata.title: 3 Step Ladder EFFIELER Folding Step Stool with Wide Anti-Slip Pedal, 500 lbs Sturdy Steel Ladder, Convenient Handgrip, Lightweight, Portable Steel Step Stool for Household, Kitchen,Office Step Ladder
features: NEW DESIGN LOCK-FREE SUPPORT FRAME：The support rod design of the EFFIELER 3-step ladder is 25% higher than the carrying capacity of the ordinary 3-step stool,The bracket and the main body are tightly connected, stable and without shaking,The folding ladder can be easily folded during storage, which is very convenient

ERGONOMIC STEP LADDER：The high-strength steel frame structure is sturdy and reliable, and the 4 non-slip mats have a strong grip,it allows you to easily climb up the 3-Step Steel Step Stool while still providing you with good support and a sense of security

3 STEP LADDER STOOL WIDELY USED：The sponge handle makes the ladder easy to carry. This is your best choice in the kitchen, utility room, and dressing room, Whether it is cleaning cabinets or tidying up closets, you can rest assured to use it, providing you with a higher safety height, If you don't use a ladder, it can be used as a beautiful plant stand
SAFETY CERTIFICATION & AFTER-SALES GUARANTEE:EFFIELER has UL, GS, CE certification, 100% money-back guarantee and 3 years warranty，Any problems with 24-hour friendly customer service

WHAT MAKES THE STEP LADDER STABLE ? The stability of the folding 3 step stool mainly depends on the thickness of the steel pipe used and the horizontal symmetry of the assembled components during the production process. EFFIELER ladders use 3mm steel pipes and perform balance tests on each ladder produced.
